gloss: side by side; in a row; uniform conformity

definitions.gloss: side by side; in a row; lined up horizontally
definitions.explanation: The physical arrangement of people or things placed next to each other in a horizontal line.

definitions.gloss: uniform conformity; keeping pace with others; herd mentality
definitions.explanation: A tendency for organizations, companies, or individuals to maintain uniformity by doing the same thing as everyone else, avoiding standing out. Often used critically.

notes:
From ⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧ (horizontal, side) + {並|なら}び (lining up). The literal sense of physical side-by-side arrangement extends metaphorically to describe conformist behavior.

USAGE:
Sense 2 is frequently used in business and social commentary to criticize Japanese organizational culture where companies or institutions copy each other rather than innovate. Often appears with ⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧ (awareness/mentality) as {横並|よこなら}び⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧.

- {横並|よこなら}び⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧ — to line up side by side
- {横並|よこなら}び⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧ — conformity mentality
- {横並|よこなら}び⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧ — uniform response (doing the same as everyone else)
- {横並|よこなら}び⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{脱|だっ}する→脱する：28650_dassuru⟧ — to break away from conformity
